title: Σχόλια εἰς τὸν Γοργίαν — Olympiodorus, Commentary on Plato's Gorgias (RU «Комментарий к „Горгию“»)
author: Olympiodorus the Younger
size: 50 lectures; Westerink Teubner 1970 about 270 pp.; est. 70–80k words (estimate)
edition: Norvin, Teubner 1936 (copyright status to check); Westerink, Teubner 1970 (standard, copyrighted).
ru_evidence: ruwiki Олимпиодор Младший lists Russian only for the Life of Plato (Gasparov 1979). CyberLeninka ('Олимпиодор … перевод') returns studies only.
en_evidence: Jackson, Lycos and Tarrant, Olympiodorus: Commentary on Plato's Gorgias (Brill 1998), per enwiki and Open Library.
value: The only extant ancient Gorgias commentary: political virtue, rhetoric versus philosophy, pagan teaching in Christian Alexandria, and allegory of the final myth. Useful for Plato reception, rhetoric and late antique education.
ai_feasibility: High. Lecture-note style and simple syntax. The myth section needs care.
pilot_unit: Lectures 46–50 on the final myth (Gorg. 523a–527e), about 8k words (estimate).
